scripts.verify:build: pnpm run verify:assets && pnpm run lint && pnpm run build
scripts.lhci:mobile: CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=mobile CABANA_LHCI_PORT=3300 pnpm exec lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.cjs
scripts.lhci:desktop: CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=desktop CABANA_LHCI_PORT=3301 pnpm exec lhci autorun --config=./lighthouserc.cjs
scripts.lhci:baseline:mobile: CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=mobile CABANA_LHCI_PORT=3300 pnpm exec lhci collect --config=./lighthouserc.cjs && CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=mobile CABANA_LHCI_PORT=3300 node scripts/perf-dashboard.cjs --write-baseline
scripts.lhci:baseline:desktop: CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=desktop CABANA_LHCI_PORT=3301 pnpm exec lhci collect --config=./lighthouserc.cjs && CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=desktop CABANA_LHCI_PORT=3301 node scripts/perf-dashboard.cjs --write-baseline
scripts.verify:perf:mobile: pnpm run lhci:mobile && CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=mobile CABANA_LHCI_PORT=3300 node scripts/perf-dashboard.cjs
scripts.verify:perf:desktop: pnpm run lhci:desktop && CABANA_LHCI_PRESET=desktop CABANA_LHCI_PORT=3301 node scripts/perf-dashboard.cjs
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run verify:build && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run verify:perf:mobile && pnpm run verify:perf:desktop
scripts.release:preview: pnpm run verify:assets && pnpm run deploy:preview
scripts.release:ship: pnpm run verify:release && pnpm run deploy:preview
